{{Quote|So much is fleeting. But I remain. And I remain the man I was. Rajivari.|Rajivari|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Rajivari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was among the founding members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the first of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].

==Biography==
===Je'daii Master and General===
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|Male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Rajivari was considered one of the wisest [[Je'daii Master]]s of the [[Je'daii Order]] and one of its top Generals. Recognized for his leadership and wisdom, Rajivari led armies during the [[Despot War]], winning many battles, but after the war he decided to lay down his weapon and live in isolation on one of the islands surrounding the Temple of [[Akar Kesh]] in order to meditate on the Force. One of his former apprentices, [[Ketu]], who had become the [[Je'daii Temple Master|Temple Master]] of Akar Kesh sometimes visited him for advice on the important matters of the Je'daii Order.<ref name="Bogan1" />

Thus, in [[25,800 BBY]], Ketu came to tell his former master about the Dark visions that [[Daegen Lok]] had allegedly seen in the depths of [[Chasm|the Chasm]], warning about the coming of an army led by an individual with one red eye and wielding a sword of fire. [[25,793 BBY|Seven years later]], Rajivari was visited again by Ketu, who came this time with news about the vision received by three [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s and the foreseen arrival of the [[Force Hound]] [[Tau (individual)|Xesh]]. Rajivari who firsthandly didn't agree with the decision of the master to not consider the vision of Lok, questioned once again the wisdom of Ketu when he learned that the stranger had been exiled on Bogan, stating that "where there is one warrior, an army may follow."<ref name="Bogan1" />

Some time later, [[Ketu]] asked Rajivari to accompany [[Tasha Ryo]] and [[Ters Sendon]] to [[Akar Kesh]] to help access the [[Holocron of A'nang|Kwa Holocron]],<ref name="Bogan4">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 4|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 4]]</ref> a relic of an [[Kwa holdings|extinct ancient and interstellar civilization]] which Ryo had accessed. However, when Ryo showed the Holocron's guardian, [[A'nang]], a skull found aboard the [[Devourer (Rakatan ship)|alien ship]], he cried "[[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]]!" and vanished.<ref name="Bogan3">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 3]]</ref>

Rajivari asked the holocron what the Rakata were. A'nang explained that the Rakata were a vicious [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark]] [[Species/Legends|Species]] who had [[Rakatan revolt|seized control of the galaxy]] and driven the Kwa to extinction.<ref name="Bogan4" />

===Founder of the Jedi Order===
Possessing considerable power, Master Rajivari was one of the first of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], convening on the world of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] and dictating the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] creed. Training the first [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Lore Keeper]]s, Rajivari secretly established the first incarnation of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] which he named the [[Fount of Rajivari]]. At some point, Master Rajivari fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and attempted to [[Rajivari's purges|destroy]] the Order he had a hand in founding. He and his several followers embraced a set of [[Principles of Rajivari|principles]] which ran counter to the Jedi and were able to hole up within the walls of the ancient Temple of Knowledge, [[Kaleth]]. Rajivari was defeated in the [[Siege of Kaleth|siege]] of his fortress, and memory of the Fount was lost to myth.<ref name="TOR" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Why would the founders keep Rajivari's image among them, after what he did?"<br />"Excellent question. To honor his previous contributions? Or a gesture of healing? Hmm.|An [[The Barsen'thor|aspiring]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and Master [[Yuon Par]] ponder over the preservation of Rajivari's holoprojector|<ref name="TOR" />}}
Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a hologram of Master Rajivari was discovered on Tython when the Order relocated from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Known as the [[Teaching hologram|Northwest hologram]], the Jedi sought to reclaim it for the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] but discovered that it had already been stolen from its hiding place. His spirit remained in the ruins of the fount until a [[The Barsen'thor|young Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] entered the place and encountered the spirit of Rajivari. Rajivari explained the history of the Fount and how it was made and that [[Nalen Raloch]] was planning to use the fount to destroy the Jedi on Tython. Master Rajivari told the Padawan to stop Raloch and save the Jedi Order. Returning the Jedi Master to the light side, the Padawan convinced him to leave the Fount and move on to become [[Force ghost/Legends|one with the Force]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Personality and traits==
Rajivari was very charismatic and as a result, he mobilized an entire army of the Order's members to follow his own views. He thought of his fallen apprentices as if his own children, gifted and loyal, initially hoping Nalen Raloch would prove as worthy despite him neglecting the value in solving Rajivari's traps at the Fount of Rajivari. Due to these traps, Nalen became crazy and Rajivari regretted teaching him because, although Rajivari wanted the Order destroyed, he would also want it rebuilt soon after but Nalen was only bent on destroying the Order, permanently.<ref name="TOR" />

==Powers and abilities==
According to Jedi Master [[Yuon Par]], Rajivari was immeasurably powerful and as a result he was able to move an army of members from the Jedi Order to follow his own principles. Further evidence of his powers was when he proved himself worthy to the droid guardians, when retrieving the hilt of the [[First Blade]]. After he was killed, Rajivari was able to become a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]].<ref name="TOR" />
